backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining posts, drafts, tagging, user profiles, and access control with role checks and validation helpers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a required fix for AuthProvider usage tied to frontend routing.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file mapping frontend file paths to short human-written summaries of their purpose.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base, component, and utility layers defining color tokens for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router defining routes with role-based guards and wrapping the app in AuthProvider.
frontend/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity and backend role/profile queries.
frontend/src/auth/useAuth.ts: Hook returning the AuthProvider context and enforcing proper usage.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI screen shown when a user lacks permission for a route.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main UI layout with navigation, user menu, role labels, and profile setup gating.
Custom React Markdown renderer handling headers, lists, inline formatting, blockquotes, code blocks, and links.
frontend/src/components/PostActions.tsx: Provides edit, publish, unpublish, and delete actions for posts with permission checks and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog for entering and saving a user's display name with basic validation and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, state, and persistence using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles and posts via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light/dark theme variables and global base styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminConsolePag: Admin console with tabs for managing content and users.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ContentManageme: Admin panel component for listing, filtering, publishing, unpublishing, and deleting posts with search and status filters.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: Simple admin user management placeholder showing info about current authentication and role-handling limitations.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page providing Internet Identity login and a placeholder admin login form with error handling.
frontend/src/pages/MyPostsPage.tsx: Displays the user's posts with tabs for all, published, and drafts and provides navigation to create or edit posts.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Shows full details of a selected post including metadata, tags, and markdown content with edit actions.
frontend/src/pages/PostEditorPage.tsx: Form for creating or editing posts with title, content, tags, validation, and submit/update logic.
frontend/src/pages/PostsListPage.tsx: Public posts list with search, tag filtering, and optional new‑post creation for engineers or admins.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling custom theme tokens, typography, container queries, animations, and extended colors and fonts.
project_state.json: Project state file describing requirements, features, issues, and architecture notes for the knowledge‑base web app.
